lines.text: Many learners say: From where are you?
Start with where, end with from.
The second! Where is he from?

data.why: Start with where, end with from.

native.tip: نبدأ بالعربية بـ «من أين أنت»، أما في الإنجليزية فتأتي where أولًا وfrom في النهاية: “Where are you from?” وليس “From where are you?”

en.hook: Do you say “From where are you”?
en.tip: In Arabic we start with «من أين أنت», but in English where comes first and from comes at the end: “Where are you from?” not “From where are you?”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “From where are you?” 😅 In Arabic we start with «من أين أنت», but in English where comes first and from comes at the end, so the right sentence is “Where are you from?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
